results.label: actual HTML loads the advisory view before the dashboard that renders it
the shipped view makes no network call of its own and loads no third-party script: every ask goes through the app’s own API helper
the view renders answer text as text nodes and never as markup
the card names the channel honestly: deterministic, read-only, no AI
the card states where answers come from and that it never writes
the card states what the channel refuses, in the trader’s words, before they ask
the card offers the server’s own example questions as chips, one per surface
the input is bounded to the module’s own limit and the send action is labelled read-only
the card carries the cannot-know list and the refusal codes it will actually receive
the card states no authority and that limits change only where the trader changes them
clicking a chip asks the server and renders one line per answer fact, each with its source
every rendered line carries its stated kind as a data attribute, so provenance is structural rather than implied
no rendered line claims an effect, a prediction or a calming result
the chip asks through POST /api/ask with the surface’s own example as the question
a typed question is sent as typed (the server trims and bounds it, the view does not rewrite it)
the answer box is replaced rather than appended: one answer container is shown at a time, holding the newest answer
a refusal renders as a refusal with its code, its reason, its citation and what it can answer instead
a refusal shows no facts at all: one note line, no surface reading and no pick
nothing in the rendered refusal offers a button that could act on the trading surfaces
an unmatched question renders the honest non-answer with the list of surfaces the channel owns
a blank question is refused by the server and the view shows the reason instead of a silent no-op
markup typed into the box is refused at the bound and never injected into the answer surface
without the surface list the card says the channel is unavailable and changes nothing about entries
an unreadable surface renders as unavailable with its source, not as a zero or an all-clear
the view is bound to the trader’s own session token, so a different workspace cannot be asked through a stale card
no uncaught error was raised by any interaction
the view keeps the trader’s typed text when a preset answer arrives elsewhere on the page

scope: M109 real DOM: the advisory card, its refusals and its provenance: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
